_note: Where each old category's professionals land in the V2 tree. V2 was written from scratch and deliberately reuses none of the old titles, so only two matched by name — the rest are proposed here and should be checked before the switch. Anything listed under _uncertain is a genuine judgement call, not a typo.
_uncertain: Music & Entertainment — 24 professionals, the largest group. Read as musical acts and sent to 'DJs, Live Bands & Musicians'. If these are magicians, dancers and hosts rather than musicians, 'Entertainment, Performers & Activities' is the right home.
DJs & Sound Services — the DJ half points one way and the sound half at 'Audio, Visual, Lighting & Staging'. Sent to the DJ category on the basis that the name leads with it.
